### New
- **Updates from inside the app** — when a new version is out, a button appears next to **Back to projects**, or next to Settings on the welcome and sign-in screens. It shows what's new, downloads the update in the background, and installs it when you restart Golden Browser, or the next time you quit. This version still needs `brew upgrade --cask golden-browser`; later ones arrive in the app.
